rapport_notes: Warm and genuinely empathetic when the customer mentioned his wife moving into memory care ('Nice.' / 'I really appreciate it and I'm glad that they took good care of you'); natural, unforced tone throughout.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiator repeated across stages; no open questions were asked that needed a held silence.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer volunteered: 'there is a big bed with six drawers... they had trouble breaking that apart... they finally used [a hammer] to break it open.' Rep response was just 'Okay.' — concern raised, no follow-up.

top_strength: Picked up on the emotional context of the move (customer's wife moving into memory care) and responded with genuine warmth rather than just plowing through the script, which builds real trust with a returning customer.
coaching_note: Never asked the top-of-call agenda/concerns question, and missed a real opening when the customer described past movers struggling to disassemble a bed — a quick 'anything else we should know going in?' would have surfaced more and earned real Stage 1 points.
